verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Power Wall as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 500 Ki, with projectile, short-mid range, 1-17 hit, and knockback characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Power Wall is obtainable from Parallel Quest 150 — Battle of the Mind. Independent Dragon Ball reference material also identifies PQ150 as the Xenoverse 2 acquisition route.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed sources establish the PQ reward route but do not provide explicit evidence sufficient to assert an Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Power Wall is kept distinct from Prominence Flash, Dragon Burn, and Chaos Wall despite similar wall/projectile characteristics.
verification_audit.damage_policy: The source reports up to 50% damage under its documented conditions; this observed value is not promoted as a canonical database damage percentage because damage can depend on character stats and version conditions.

records.name: Power Wall
records.character_source: Jiren (Full Power); Jiren - Customize Partner; Jiren (Full Power) Ultra Supervillain
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 150 — Battle of the Mind
records.skill_description: Generate a giant wall of flame that advances and damages opponents on contact; the control stick can alter its distance from the user.
records.mechanics_notes: The user charges the right hand and swipes downward to create a tall wall of flames. Opponents can be caught during the charge-up stage, and the wall advances after creation. Control-stick input manages the wall's distance away from the user.
